entries.title: I Peter 2:1
segments: ¶Therefore, laying aside all malice, all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and all evil speaking,

entries.title: I Peter 2:2
segments: as newborn babes, desire the pure milk of the word, that you may grow thereby,

entries.title: I Peter 2:3
segments: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord [is] gracious.

entries.title: I Peter 2:4
segments: ¶Coming to Him [as to] a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God [and] precious,

entries.title: I Peter 2:5
segments: you also, as living stones, are being built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Peter 2:6
segments: Therefore it is also contained in the Scripture, "Behold, I lay in Zion A chief cornerstone, elect, precious, And he who believes on Him will by no means be put to shame."

entries.title: I Peter 2:7
segments: Therefore, to you who believe, [He is] precious; but to those who are disobedient, "The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone,"

entries.title: I Peter 2:8
segments: and "A stone of stumbling And a rock of offense." They stumble, being disobedient to the word, to which they also were appointed.

entries.title: I Peter 2:9
segments: But you [are] a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, His own special people, that you may proclaim the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;

entries.title: I Peter 2:10
segments: who once [were] not a people but [are] now the people of God, who had not obtained mercy but now have obtained mercy.

entries.title: I Peter 2:11
segments: Beloved, I beg [you] as sojourners and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

entries.title: I Peter 2:12
segments: having your conduct honorable among the Gentiles, that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may, by [your] good works which they observe, glorify God in the day of visitation.

entries.title: I Peter 2:13
segments: ¶Therefore submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake, whether to the king as supreme,

entries.title: I Peter 2:14
segments: or to governors, as to those who are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers and [for the] praise of those who do good.

entries.title: I Peter 2:15
segments: For this is the will of God, that by doing good you may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men--

entries.title: I Peter 2:16
segments: as free, yet not using liberty as a cloak for vice, but as bondservants of God.

entries.title: I Peter 2:17
segments: Honor all [people]. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

entries.title: I Peter 2:18
segments: Servants, [be] submissive to [your] masters with all fear, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the harsh.

entries.title: I Peter 2:19
segments: For this [is] commendable, if because of conscience toward God one endures grief, suffering wrongfully.

entries.title: I Peter 2:20
segments: For what credit [is it] if, when you are beaten for your faults, you take it patiently? But when you do good and suffer, if you take it patiently, this [is] commendable before God.

entries.title: I Peter 2:21
segments: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that you should follow His steps:

entries.title: I Peter 2:22
segments: "Who committed no sin, Nor was deceit found in His mouth";

entries.title: I Peter 2:23
segments: who, when He was reviled, did not revile in return; when He suffered, He did not threaten, but committed [Himself] to Him who judges righteously;

entries.title: I Peter 2:24
segments: who Himself bore our sins in His own body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live for righteousness--by whose stripes you were healed.

entries.title: I Peter 2:25
segments: For you were like sheep going astray, but have now returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
